invariants.rationale: The method iterates over 'layers'; it will throw a NullPointerException if 'layers' is null.
The .length of a Java array is always non-negative.
Layer indices should be non-negative integers as they are used to access mapLayers.get(i).
It is likely that rendering the same layer multiple times is undesired, so 'layers' likely contains no duplicates.
All layer indices should be within the bounds of mapLayers; accessing out-of-bounds would throw an exception.
